summary: Iter 6 retest (frontend only) — verified Iter 5 fixes in /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx. (1) Off-site tab now renders correctly: 5 rows, each with testID=offsite-{id}, showing user_name, distance_m, depot_name, lat/lng, and clock_in timestamp; 5 Map buttons with testID=map-{id} present. (2) Tapping a Map button fires Linking.openURL which on web maps to window.open — captured 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=0,-30' for the first row → no crash, request initiated. (3) Send Weekly Digest API returns 200 with new shape {ok, mocked: true, recipients[], bundles:[{depot_name, filename}], digest_ids[]}. The admin.tsx sendDigest handler correctly maps data.bundles into '• {depot}: {filename}' lines with a MOCKED prefix when data.mocked is true (verified by static code review at lines 97-113); no JS crash on click. RN-web Alert.alert does not surface as window.alert nor as a DOM dialog in headless Playwright, which prevented direct UI capture of the alert text — but API + handler logic is correct. Backend was 13/13 in Iter 5 and was not re-run (frontend-only request).
